Then trigger = self.pickuptrigger; if isdefined( trigger ): trigger.origin = ( self.origin[0], self.origin[1], self.origin[2] + 10 ) (10 units above the settled knife); trigger linkto( self ). summary.behavior: Projectile land handler threaded with (watcher, player); self is the thrown ballistic-knife projectile entity. Cancellation: one combined player endon(#"death",#"disconnect"), level endon(#"game_ended"). Waits: waitresult = self waittill(#"stationary", #"death") â€” wait result carries position, normal, direction, attacker, target (prey), bone_name. If !isdefined( self ) -> return. Reads endpos, normal, angles(=direction), attacker, prey(=target), bone. isfriendly = 0. If isdefined( endpos ): spawns "script_model" retrievable_model at endpos; ordered setup: setmodel( watcher.weapon.projectilemodel ), setteam( player.team ), setowner( player ), .owner = player, .angles = angles, .name = watcher.weapon, .weapon = watcher.weapon, .targetname = "sticky_weapon". If prey defined: .prey = prey; if level.teambased && player.team == prey.team -> isfriendly = 1; if !isfriendly: if isalive( prey ) || !isdefined( prey gettagorigin( bone ) ) -> retrievable_model droptoground( retrievable_model.origin, 80 ) (local variant), else linkto( prey, bone ) (sticks to the victim's hit bone). Else (friendly hit): physicslaunch( normal, ( randomint(10), randomint(10), randomint(10) ) ) and normal reset to ( 0, 0, 1 ). Then .normal = normal; appends retrievable_model to watcher.objectarray (watcher.objectarray[ watcher.objectarray.size ]); if isfriendly -> retrievable_model waittill(#"stationary"); if !isdefined( retrievable_model ) -> return (deleted during wait); retrievable_model thread dropknivestoground(); player notify(#"ballistic_knife_stationary", { #retrievable_model:retrievable_model }). Team-filtering/ownership: model carries thrower team & owner; friendly hit prevents sticking-in-body.
unknowns: waittill(#"stationary",#"death") multi-event result layout (position/normal/direction/attacker/target/bone_name) is engine-provided; only field names observed
Whether watcher.objectarray pre-exists / is cleaned elsewhere lives in weaponobjects (owner dependency)

summary.behavior: Re-drop of a grounded knife within a level event radius (origin, radius args; self = retrievable model). Branch: if distancesquared( origin, self.origin ) < radius * radius -> self physicslaunch( ( 0, 0, 1 ), ( 5, 5, 5 ) ) (upward nudge) then self thread updateretrievetrigger() which waits for stationary and re-links the pickup trigger. No writes outside self/its trigger.

summary.behavior: Retrieval-trigger setup, called by the weaponobjects watcher machinery with (watcher, player); this body never reads self; the actual callback receiver remains unresolved. The retrievable_model is received from the player notification. Cancellation: two separate calls player endon(#"death") and player endon(#"disconnect"), level endon(#"game_ended"). Waits: player waittill(#"ballistic_knife_stationary"); retrievable_model = waitresult.retrievable_model; return if undefined. Reads normal = retrievable_model.normal, prey = retrievable_model.prey; vec_scale = 10. Trigger position selection: if prey defined && ( isplayer( prey ) || isai( prey ) ) -> trigger_pos = prey.origin + ( 0, 0, vec_scale ); else trigger_pos = retrievable_model.origin + vec_scale * normal. State writes: clientfield::set( "retrievable", 1 ) and clientfield::set( "enemyequip", 1 ) on retrievable_model; retrievable_model weaponobjects::function_57152a5( watcher, player, trigger_pos ) (weaponobjects helper that creates the pickup trigger); retrievable_model.pickuptrigger enablelinkto(); pickuptrigger linkto( prey ) if prey defined else linkto( retrievable_model ). Finally retrievable_model thread weaponobjects::watchshutdown( player ).
